verdict.rationale: Anytime Mailbox states its address 'meets business registration requirements in most states' and serves as a real street address, but there is no documentation specifically addressing bank or payment-processor acceptance (e.g., KYC/1583 requirements) or explicit caveats about where it doesn't work for financial institutions. Missing for 10: explicit bank/payment-processor acceptance guidance, documented limitations or edge cases (e.g., which banks reject virtual addresses), and any first-party statement distinguishing business registration from banking KYC use.
